title: Metal and glass reflect the sky everywhere
caption: #366. The monorail's reflective steel is now one shared finish for the whole game: glass and steel reflect the sky of the place and the time of day (morning, day, dusk), with a low street round it. The monorail looks as it did. Lamps, signs, bins, drinks machines, rails, bike racks and roof plant are painted or bare steel; the sports hall, the north-street office and the harbour hut's glass show sky above and the street below.

sections.title: The monorail, train place
sections.caption: The car skin before and after the move to the shared finish: the same picture.

sections.title: Sports district: the hall and the north-street office
sections.caption: The glazing reflected a fixed hand-made pale map; now the period's sky above and a hazed street below, moving with the camera.

sections.title: Harbour: the foreman's hut and the bike rack
sections.caption: The hut window takes the shared glass; the rack bar is painted steel and the hoops bare steel.

sections.title: Forecourt: lamps and the station
sections.caption: Lamp posts are painted steel with a soft sheen of the sky; after work they catch the warm dusk on one edge.

sections.title: Dorm courtyard: drinks machines and lamp
sections.caption: The machine housings and the lamp post are painted steel.
